Friendzy / Classic party games / The Silent Actor

How to play The Silent Actor

No words. Just you and your body. Pure charades. Act out a person, animal, job, movie, or phrase — completely silently. The group races to guess. First correct guess wins.

2–10 players~8 minPhysical & CompetitiveActing & performance games

How to play

  1. One player is given (or thinks of) a person, animal, job, movie title, or phrase.
  2. They must act it out with no sounds whatsoever — no humming, no mouthing words.
  3. The group shouts guesses freely and rapidly.
  4. First correct guess scores a point for the guesser.
  5. Set a 60-second time limit — if nobody guesses, the actor reveals and no points scored.

Example round

  • Acting out 'dentist' — opening mouth wide, pretending to drill, wincing in pain
  • Acting out 'Titanic' — arms wide on an imaginary bow, then sinking dramatically
  • Acting out 'anxiety' — everyone immediately knows. Too real.

Tips

  • For abstract concepts, act out something that represents it rather than the thing itself.
  • Speed matters — the faster you commit to a gesture, the faster people guess.
